categories.main_business_segments: Ligao Foods primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of frozen baked foods and baking ingredients. Their product portfolio includes frozen semi-finished and finished baked goods such as mochi, tart shells, donuts, and frozen cakes, as well as baking raw materials like cream, fruit products, sauces, oils, and meat floss products. The company serves diverse channels including bakeries, supermarkets, catering, tea beverage shops, convenience stores, and e-commerce.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced frozen baking technology, including automated production lines imported from Switzerland and the Netherlands, customized and optimized for domestic raw materials and products. They emphasize product formula innovation, automated production line upgrades, and strict quality control systems. Their production methods include cold chain storage and transportation at -18°C to maintain product quality and shelf life of 6 to 9 months.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ligao Foods serves a broad customer base including bakery shops, large supermarket chains, catering businesses, tea and coffee chains, convenience stores, and online retail platforms. Their products cater to both professional baking enterprises and non-professional outlets requiring ready-to-bake frozen products. The company also targets industrial baking and food service sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangzhou (South China), Zhejiang (East China), and Henan (North China), covering all provinces except Taiwan. It also has subsidiaries in Japan and the United States, supporting international R&D and sales. Their marketing network spans all Chinese provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, and special administrative regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ligao Foods operates mainly in the midstream of the baking supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying frozen baked goods and baking ingredients. They manage procurement of raw materials, in-house production, and distribution logistics, including cold chain warehousing and transportation. The company also engages in limited outsourced OEM production for non-core products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in product formulas, production automation, and cold chain logistics. It invests in R&D to develop new baking ingredients and frozen products aligned with consumer trends towards health, convenience, and quality. Ligao Foods maintains overseas R&D centers, collaborates with international experts, and actively participates in industry standard setting. Future plans include expanding production capacity, digitalizing supply chain management, and international market development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of frozen baked goods and baking ingredients via a combination of buyout sales to distributors (majority), direct sales to large chain customers, and limited online retail. The company also earns income from warehousing and logistics services. Pricing strategies consider product cost and market demand, with sales conducted through extensive dealer networks and direct customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ligao Foods holds a leading position in China's frozen baking and baking ingredient industry, recognized for its scale, technology, product diversity, and channel coverage. It competes with domestic and international baking ingredient manufacturers and frozen food producers. The company is acknowledged as a specialized and innovative SME in Guangdong and has received multiple industry awards and certifications, positioning itself as a top-tier baking integrated service provider.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ligao Foods reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.84 billion, a 9.61% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 268 million, up 266.94%. The company has shown strong growth in high-margin baking ingredients, especially UHT cream products. Total assets exceeded RMB 4.37 billion, with ongoing investments in production capacity expansion and digital transformation. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to optimize cost structures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ligao Foods emphasizes product quality, safety, and innovation, offering a comprehensive one-stop solution with nearly a thousand product SKUs covering frozen baked goods and baking ingredients. Their products feature high standardization, convenience, and diverse flavor profiles catering to various customer needs. The company leverages advanced automation, proprietary formulas, and cold chain logistics to ensure consistent product quality and supply reliability, differentiating itself through technical leadership and extensive service support.
